name: debtmap
description: Map the risk hiding in a codebase: security exposure and bug-proneness, ranked and explained.

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build: npm run build -w @debtmap/shared && npm run build -w @debtmap/analyzer && npm run build -w @debtmap/api && npm run build -w @debtmap/web
